lead_independence.lead: Three people were previously charged in the death of a 3-month-old baby who allegedly died from severe dehydration and malnutrition: the child's mother, 27-year-old Nicole Maxwell; the child's grandfather, Robert Maxwell; and Robert Maxwell's girlfriend, 38-year-old Vikki Koon. lead_independence.headline: Deputies search Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud investigation
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office deputies served a search warrant Tuesday morning at the Fort Pierce home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard as part of the ongoing Southern Truss fraud investigation. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the residence. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that Jason Gunter, the biological father of a 3-month-old baby who allegedly died from severe dehydration and malnutrition, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia. Detectives had obtained an arrest warrant for Gunter in connection with the ongoing investigation into the child's death. He has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.
